title: Bless the Lord, O My Soul
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about being met with a hug before the mess is mentioned, and Willow the Warm is the Traveler who feels how gentle and forgiving love can be.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she feels how gentle and forgiving love can be. In Willow’s world today: Willow spilled her juice all over the floor and felt scared she was in trouble. But Mom just gave her a hug and said, “It’s okay — let’s clean it up together.” Willow’s worried heart melted into a happy one. Just like David sang about Heavenly Father’s kind, forgiving love, Willow felt how big and gentle that love can be.
